purpose: Research item A7 — 'route the instrumental BED and the VOCAL separately, then mix'. This file is the EVIDENCE LAYER for which layers can be generated as separate paths, which cannot, and why. music_studio/routing.py reads it; it holds no capability literal of its own.
the_constraint_chain_that_shapes_this_fi: A7 as WRITTEN gives the vocal note-level control, which in the research meant SoulX-Singer.

D-SSM-24 (his order 2026-08-14, 'herşey kesinlikle vertex ve google ın kendi servisleir ile olmalı') removes SoulX-Singer as a third-party MODEL wherever it runs. Architecture 2c.3 states the consequence plainly: 'note-level vocal timing has NO Google path today, and that is stated, not hidden.'
The only Google sung surface is lyria-3-pro-preview, and it returns a MIXED song — vocal together with its own accompaniment. There is no Google vocal-only generator.
Obtaining a vocal-only signal therefore requires SEPARATION of that mix. MANDATE CLAUSE 15, verbatim: 'A separated stem is analysis-grade and may never be shipped.'

CONCLUSION, derived and not chosen: layering a separated vocal over an independently generated bed would SHIP a separated stem and is refused. The lawful two-path form uses layers that are each ENGINE-GENERATED WHOLE.

delivery_class_rule.ENGINE_GENERATED: SHIPPABLE — the engine produced this audio as a whole signal.
delivery_class_rule.SEPARATED_STEM: ANALYSIS_ONLY — CLAUSE 15. Lawful for measurement (the A8 intelligibility gate reads the separated vocal), never for delivery.
delivery_class_rule.why_derived_not_settable: A field a caller can set to SHIPPABLE would let a stem be shipped by writing one word. The class is computed from the origin so the guard cannot be bypassed by data.

layers.control_surface: the full typed stack stays authoritative: structure -> [mm:ss] section prose, tempo_bpm, key, time_signature, instruments, mood_orbit, energy_curve
layers.evidence: A7: 'the existing typed controls stay authoritative for the bed'. Generation-proven on this project: the intro package produced its score bed on Lyria (docs/moviemaker/INTRO_ENGINE.md).
layers.measured_caveat: duration is NOT requestable on lyria-002 — measured 139.26 / 146.73 / 159.63 s unasked, which is why duration.on_miss exists.

layers.control_surface: its own prompt, separate from the music bed's — this is what makes it a second PATH rather than a tag on the first
layers.evidence: Architecture 2c.3: 'FX/Ambience stem GENERATION moves from the ElevenLabs/fal SFX routes (already credit-ineligible) to Lyria prompt-directed beds — the intro package already produced its score bed on Lyria, so this path is generation-proven in kind.' The stems parameter already exposes fx and ambience.
layers.measured_caveat: 'generation-proven in kind' is NOT the same as generation-proven for FX specifically. No FX-only Lyria take has been measured on this project, so this layer is available in PLAN and UNMEASURED in delivery until one is run.

layers.control_surface: its own prompt; longer, flatter energy than the FX bed
layers.evidence: same clause as FX_BED; the stems parameter lists ambience as its own stem.
layers.measured_caveat: same as FX_BED — unmeasured for this specific use.

refusal.reason: No Google service generates a vocal-only signal. The only Google sung surface (lyria-3-pro-preview) returns a MIXED song, so an isolated vocal can only be obtained by separating that mix — and CLAUSE 15 forbids shipping a separated stem.
refusal.law: MANDATE CLAUSE 15 ('A separated stem is analysis-grade and may never be shipped') + D-SSM-24 (Google-only, which removed SoulX-Singer)
refusal.what_is_still_lawful: The sung take is delivered AS A WHOLE by lyria-3-pro-preview (single-path), and its separated vocal is used for MEASUREMENT only — which is exactly what the A8 intelligibility gate needs.
what_would_unblock_it: a Google/Vertex surface that generates a vocal-only take (none known; would need a capability probe, and a printed enum is never capability evidence — MANDATE CLAUSE 6)
his explicit suspension of CLAUSE 15 for this case, which is his decision and not mine
refusal.not_a_workaround: Turning the TTS route into the delivered vocal was the OLD fallback and the research itself calls it a downgrade ('upgrades it from "align TTS onto a bed"'). It is not offered here as a substitute.

refusal.reason: Research item A6: the fallback voice-identity path is speech prompt -> SPEECH-TO-SINGING style transfer, with voice_vertex_tts (Turkish, generation-proven, on disk at voice_vertex_tts/lambda_function.py - verified 2026-08-16) as the PROMPT source, never the final vocal. The PROMPT half is Google and lawful. The STS STAGE half has NO Google path: the research's measured STS engines (TCSinger 2: FFE 0.24 / Cos 0.89 / MOS-S 3.96; SVPT: LSD 4.750, language-agnostic) are third-party MODELS - exactly the class D-SSM-24 removed when it superseded A5's SoulX-Singer - and no Vertex/Google speech-to-singing surface is known.
refusal.law: D-SSM-24 ('hersey kesinlikle vertex ve google in kendi servisleir ile olmali') - the same ground as A5 SUPERSEDED and the Phonsa/STARS blocks in data/aligners.json
refusal.what_is_still_lawful: voice_vertex_tts remains live for SPOKEN deliverables, and the registry's speech axis tracks it (SPEECH_PROVEN is its unlock path). Nothing about A6's prompt half is wasted: the moment an STS stage exists, the prompt source is already generation-proven.
what_would_unblock_it: a Google/Vertex speech-to-singing surface (none known; a printed enum would not count - MANDATE CLAUSE 6 requires a completed generation)
Berk explicitly widening D-SSM-24 to admit a third-party STS model - his decision, the same open question already queued for CharsiuG2P (TR-G2P3)
refusal.not_a_workaround: Aligning raw TTS onto a bed as the delivered vocal is NOT offered as a substitute: the research itself calls A6 an UPGRADE from exactly that ('upgrades it from align TTS onto a bed to a 2026-measured capability'), so shipping the un-styled TTS would be the downgrade class.

mix_stage.position: between Stage 4 (measure) and Stage 5 (conform), because conform trims the ASSEMBLED programme
mix_stage.rule: every source layer must be SHIPPABLE. A MixPlan containing any ANALYSIS_ONLY layer is refused at plan time, before a single billable call.
mix_stage.reuses: music_studio/mastering.py for loudness and true-peak; the mix stage never re-implements normalisation (single source of truth).
mix_stage.unmeasured: no multi-layer mix has been rendered on this project yet. The plan is buildable and control-testable at $0; the DELIVERED mix is unmeasured and is labelled so.
